## User need

Who needs this and what task are they trying to complete?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the visible result and the role(s) affected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expected behavior is defined.
- [ ] Relevant role and course-access rules are defined.
- [ ] Error/empty states are defined.

## Scope and verification

What is included, excluded, and how should the team verify it?
